# BeeGoods.co

A developing bee-inspired goods brand connected to Med Bee Tate and Industry Army Marketing. No online checkout, confirmed stock or open venue bookings are announced here.

- [The next little buzz: why BeeGoods exists](https://beegoods.co/journal/the-next-little-buzz/): BeeGoods is the goods-focused next chapter beside Med Bee Tate. Here is what we are building, and what we want to get right.
- [A honey jar should tell you its story](https://beegoods.co/journal/honey-label-questions/): A useful buying checklist starts with origin, the product description and the maker—not a beautiful label alone.
- [Make your own honey tasting notes](https://beegoods.co/journal/honey-tasting-notes/): A simple way to remember what you enjoy without turning breakfast into a competition.
- [Before you give honey as a gift](https://beegoods.co/journal/honey-gift-questions/): Think about the recipient, the occasion and the information that should travel with the jar.
- [Know what is in a wax product](https://beegoods.co/journal/beeswax-material-questions/): A material name is the beginning of a product description, not the whole explanation.
- [Choose a candle for the room it will live in](https://beegoods.co/journal/candle-as-an-object/): Shape, scale, scent preferences and product instructions all belong in the decision.
- [What we want to know about a handmade soap](https://beegoods.co/journal/soap-maker-introduction/): Useful product information helps a maker’s work speak for itself.
- [A small gift can carry a good story](https://beegoods.co/journal/small-gift-big-thought/): Choose a reason for the gift before choosing more things to put in the box.
- [Useful textiles, quieter everyday moments](https://beegoods.co/journal/linen-and-everyday-rituals/): Start with what an object needs to do, then decide whether its material and design suit the task.
- [A good maker story starts with specifics](https://beegoods.co/journal/a-good-maker-story/): Show the work, name the material and make the next step clear.
- [From a market stall to a useful product page](https://beegoods.co/journal/market-stall-to-web-page/): Bring the clarity of a good in-person introduction onto the screen.
- [BeeGoods and Med Bee Tate: connected, with different jobs](https://beegoods.co/journal/bee-goods-and-med-bee-tate/): A place-based concept and a goods brand can share a thread without becoming the same website.
- [Introducing your goods: a maker’s checklist](https://beegoods.co/journal/what-to-send-a-collection-buyer/): A focused first message helps us understand both the work and the practical fit.
- [A collection should have a point of view](https://beegoods.co/journal/collection-not-catalogue/): Adding more items is easy. Explaining why they belong together is the creative work.
- [Concept, stock or actual product: the caption matters](https://beegoods.co/journal/concept-photo-or-stock/): A clear image credit helps you understand what a picture can—and cannot—tell you.
- [What needs to be ready before a first order](https://beegoods.co/journal/before-a-first-order/): A beautiful launch page is only one part of becoming ready to sell.
- [Honey & the table](https://beegoods.co/honey/): A good jar deserves a clear story.
- [Wax, warmth & everyday goods](https://beegoods.co/home-goods/): Objects with texture. Details that make sense.
- [Small gifts. Good stories.](https://beegoods.co/gifts/): Thoughtful gestures, with a little buzz.
- [One idea leads to another.](https://beegoods.co/our-story/): Treatments.tv. Med Bee Tate. And now, BeeGoods.
- [Make something worth meeting?](https://beegoods.co/for-makers/): Introduce your goods and the story behind them.
- [Privacy & clear next steps](https://beegoods.co/privacy/): A simple, enquiry-led launch site.
- [The BeeGoods journal](https://beegoods.co/journal/): Ideas for the table, the home and the next little buzz. Explore 16 original launch stories.
- [Say hello to BeeGoods](https://beegoods.co/contact/): Email the launch team about collection ideas, maker introductions and future gifts.
- [A little more good. A little more buzz.](https://beegoods.co/): BeeGoods is a developing bee-inspired goods brand: honey, wax, thoughtful gifts and maker stories, connected to Med Bee Tate.
